note: Matches Emacs' basic defvar (first-defvar-wins; a variable already bound is left alone). kg's defvar asks boundp rather than reading the variable, specifically because an unbound kg variable now raises void-variable (src/lisp_prelude.c's own comment) -- a deliberate implementation detail that produces the same observable contract as Emacs, not a divergence. ("expect": "agree": this case pins first-defvar-wins. prelude-defvar-special pins the special-variable half, which kg did not match until Phase 11 and now does.)
